nodes.Name: SetLogLoggerLevel
nodes.DocComment:
SetLogLoggerLevel controls the level for the bridge to the [log] package.

Before [SetDefault] is called, slog top-level logging functions call the default [log.Logger].
In that mode, SetLogLoggerLevel sets the minimum level for those calls.
By default, the minimum level is Info, so calls to [Debug]
(as well as top-level logging calls at lower levels)
will not be passed to the log.Logger. After calling

	slog.SetLogLoggerLevel(slog.LevelDebug)

calls to [Debug] will be passed to the log.Logger.

After [SetDefault] is called, calls to the default [log.Logger] are passed to the
slog default handler. In that mode,
SetLogLoggerLevel sets the level at which those calls are logged.
That is, after calling

	slog.SetLogLoggerLevel(slog.LevelDebug)

A call to [log.Printf] will result in output at level [LevelDebug].

SetLogLoggerLevel returns the previous value.

nodes.Name: Default
nodes.DocComment: Default returns the default [Logger].

nodes.Name: SetDefault
nodes.DocComment:
SetDefault makes l the default [Logger], which is used by
the top-level functions [Info], [Debug] and so on.
After this call, output from the log package's default Logger
(as with [log.Print], etc.) will be logged using l's Handler,
at a level controlled by [SetLogLoggerLevel].

nodes.Name: handlerWriter
nodes.DocComment:
handlerWriter is an io.Writer that calls a Handler.
It is used to link the default log.Logger to the default slog.Logger.

nodes.Name: Logger
nodes.DocComment:
A Logger records structured information about each call to its
Log, Debug, Info, Warn, and Error methods.
For each call, it creates a [Record] and passes it to a [Handler].

To create a new Logger, call [New] or a Logger method
that begins "With".

nodes.Name: Handler
nodes.DocComment: Handler returns l's Handler.

nodes.Name: With
nodes.DocComment:
With returns a Logger that includes the given attributes
in each output operation. Arguments are converted to
attributes as if by [Logger.Log].

nodes.Name: WithGroup
nodes.DocComment:
WithGroup returns a Logger that starts a group, if name is non-empty.
The keys of all attributes added to the Logger will be qualified by the given
name. (How that qualification happens depends on the [Handler.WithGroup]
method of the Logger's Handler.)

If name is empty, WithGroup returns the receiver.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment: New creates a new Logger with the given non-nil Handler.

nodes.Name: With
nodes.DocComment: With calls [Logger.With] on the default logger.

nodes.Name: Enabled
nodes.DocComment: Enabled reports whether l emits log records at the given context and level.

nodes.Name: NewLogLogger
nodes.DocComment:
NewLogLogger returns a new [log.Logger] such that each call to its Output method
dispatches a Record to the specified handler. The logger acts as a bridge from
the older log API to newer structured logging handlers.

nodes.Name: Log
nodes.DocComment:
Log emits a log record with the current time and the given level and message.
The Record's Attrs consist of the Logger's attributes followed by
the Attrs specified by args.

The attribute arguments are processed as follows:
  - If an argument is an Attr, it is used as is.
  - If an argument is a string and this is not the last argument,
    the following argument is treated as the value and the two are combined
    into an Attr.
  - Otherwise, the argument is treated as a value with key "!BADKEY".

nodes.Name: LogAttrs
nodes.DocComment: LogAttrs is a more efficient version of [Logger.Log] that accepts only Attrs.

nodes.Name: Debug
nodes.DocComment: Debug logs at [LevelDebug].

nodes.Name: DebugContext
nodes.DocComment: DebugContext logs at [LevelDebug] with the given context.

nodes.Name: Info

nodes.Name: Warn

nodes.Name: WarnContext

nodes.Name: Error
nodes.DocComment: Error logs at [LevelError].

nodes.Name: ErrorContext
nodes.DocComment: ErrorContext logs at [LevelError] with the given context.

nodes.Name: log
nodes.DocComment:
log is the low-level logging method for methods that take ...any.
It must always be called directly by an exported logging method
or function, because it uses a fixed call depth to obtain the pc.

nodes.Name: logAttrs
nodes.DocComment: logAttrs is like [Logger.log], but for methods that take ...Attr.
